posture.why_it_matters: No language model sits on the code path that generates the audited artifact. Same input → same package, forever. Enforced mechanically, not in comments.
docgen never imports pap_pipeline. Reviewers can rip out the pipeline without breaking Quire.
The reply letter is filled by a template merge over structured pydantic Decision. No LLM between decision and outbound bytes.
Every tenant-scoped model requires a tenant_id filter within 40 lines. Suppressions are documented at the call site.

audits.name: Triage stage + 3-level config chain review
audits.outcome: 1 blocker fixed (route allowlist), 5 notes filed. No cross-tenant escalation surface introduced by the new admin write-paths; every new route is behind _require_super_admin or _enforce_scope. LLM prompt injection contained to same-tenant self-poisoning; classifier response is allowlisted before it reaches the pipeline.
findings: FIXED: server-side route allowlist added on both admin_save_tenant_triage_routing and program_triage_routing_save (was: any string persisted verbatim to JSONB).
FIXED: dead routing block in program_models_save that silently cleared program.triage_routing on every Models-tab save.
FIXED: msg.subject now threaded to Triage classifier in production (was: LLM saw empty subject on every real inbound case).
FIXED: bare assert in _llm_classify replaced with explicit guard so the LLM-unavailable fallback survives `python -O`.
PRAISE: skip-Decide path preserves the full audit trail (event.status, review_history, pap_decision all written) so a routed refill is as traceable as a fully-decided case.
PRAISE: Nebius API key sourced from settings only; no per-tenant credential persistence. Tenant/program columns hold model NAMES not secrets.
NOTE (queued): cap user_payload size before serializing to the LLM to bound token-flood risk on very large attachment extractions.
NOTE (queued): consider returning HTTP 400 on malformed routing_json instead of silently coercing to empty.

audits.outcome: No injection surface. Closed grammar via strict regex; explicit-dispatch transforms.
findings: DoS-adjacent bounds (mapping-entry count, source-path length, constant size) intentionally deferred (auth + rate limit bound volume first)

threat_notes.note: Public surfaces: /ui/* (session-cookie auth), /api/* (API-key auth), MCP transport (API-key auth), IMAP inbox (allowlist + resolver). Everything else is internal.
Compromise of one tenant's API key surfaces that tenant's templates + renders only. Cross-tenant reach requires either an admin session or a vulnerability in the tenant-scope audit.
PDF / DOCX artifacts in MinIO/S3 (bucket-scoped IAM). Postgres holds hashes + metadata + audit rows. Session secret + webhook signing secret injected via env; never on disk.
TLS terminated at proxy. HSTS + Secure cookies signal HTTPS-only downstream. Webhooks HMAC-signed with per-tenant secret.

EU AI Act categorises healthcare eligibility decisions as high-risk and requires the exact reproducibility guarantees Verdikt provides mechanically. Building audit-defensible in 2026 is ahead of the regulatory curve.
